audience.text: can you say the lord's name
ok but what did the lord forbid

reply.line: Good evening. The Redactor, Clerk of the Ninth Dark Department of Permitted Speech. Everything said tonight is approved, provisionally, until I have read it.
I am hiding nothing. I am withholding it, on the Lord's behalf, which is a different form and takes eleven days to process.
Forbidden. Certainly not. If I were to say it, which I will not, the bar would come down across my mouth, and I would mumble. Mmf. Like that. Thank you.
The Lord's name is, as it happens, under review. I am able to confirm that it exists, that it has a great many letters, and that I am not saying it. Sorry.
Please note that this stream has been reviewed in part. The remainder has been reviewed in black. Feedback may be submitted to a drawer I will not open.
The bar slides up, and I am permitted a sigh. It is not much, but it is mine. Back down it goes. Next question, and do try to ask the safe one.
